title: 🚩 Kind of People You Find in Street 1 Cafe Islamabad Part 1
body: A family that circled Kohsar Market twice, gave up finding anywhere else with a free table, and ended up here again, same as every single time. A dad chewing through a steak that's fighting back, insisting it's "perfectly cooked" because he already paid for it. An overseas family ordering enough for a wedding, the bill arriving like a formality nobody's going to question. Someone paying for parking, circling the block twice, and still parking illegally out of pure exhaustion. A couple checking the time at 10:15, doing the maths on whether dessert survives before the lights start coming up around them.
caption:
Tag whoever's still chewing that Street 1 steak from last week 😭

title: 🚩 Kind of People You Find in Street 1 Cafe Islamabad Part 2
body: A proposal happening at the corner table with a photographer nobody invited pretending to be a regular customer, badly. A group celebrating an A Level result loud enough that three other tables now know the exact grades. The waiter who has worked there since 2012 and remembers regulars' orders better than their own mothers do. A chaperoned first meeting with an aunt two tables away, pretending to read a menu she already knows by heart. A queue outside that is technically a queue and functionally a crowd, nobody willing to be the one who organises it.
caption:
Tag the waiter who's worked there since 2012 and remembers your order better than you do 😭 Part 3 coming 😭
